landing.title: Your friends are lying to you.
landing.subtitle: Secret missions, clue deals and buzzer showdowns—straight from everyone’s phone.

meta.title: A party game of secrets, clues and missions
meta.description: Secrets is a mobile-first realtime party game. Build teams, run secret missions, trade clues and buzz your friends from every phone, with a big-screen dashboard for the room.

moments.title: Someone buzzes
moments.line: Guess someone’s secret and take their money.

moments.title: The room erupts
moments.line: The big screen flares red, names who accused whom, and locks until the host rules.
moments.quote: Théo has been lying about that vault key all night.

moments.title: Cracked it — or not
moments.line: Nail it and their secret is blown open for the room. Miss it and you just gave your money to the enemy.

moments.title: Share or steal
moments.line: Share or steal? Find out who’s really your friend.

moments.title: Secrets spill
moments.line: The moment a secret drops, every clue anyone ever bought about that player lands in the shared Vault.

landing.fairLine: Play money only. Nobody ever gets knocked out.

cta.title: Gather your friends. Keep your secrets.

footer.rights: Not affiliated with any TV show. No third-party names, logos or assets.
